build_simple_candidate_generator: build a Simple_Candidate_Generator that queries Solr to retrieve Wikipedia entity candidates for a given mention
run_get_candidates: run get_candidates on a Simple_Candidate_Generator to retrieve filtered candidate entities from Solr for mention data
create_pregenerated_candidates_fetcher: create a Pregenerated_Candidates_Data_Fetcher to fetch enriched candidate data by Wikidata ID from Solr
test_filter_result: test the filter_result static method to extract wikidata_id, wikipedia_id, title, aliases, and sentences from a Solr candidate document
summarize_mention_data: summarize mention data by extracting the mention text and its truncated 25-word context using mention_data_summary
